data.Name: GRAND — Early water breakthrough and high WOR risk
data.Summary: Thin heavy-oil zone above active aquifer may cause early water production and lower recovery.
data.Description:
High viscosity and a thin oil column above an active aquifer may drive early breakthrough and reserves loss.

Key Uncertainty — Early water breakthrough [High]: Thin and heavy oil zone directly above an active aquifer. Recovery may be low due to high oil viscosity and thin oil column thickness. ICD/AICD and subsea pumps under evaluation.
